shared_schema.validation: Single shared request/state validation layer enforces exact fields, types, unique IDs, references, nonnegative finite prices/budget, prerequisite DAG and completed-step consistency. Each boundary recomputes prior deterministic stage outputs to validate structure, semantics and provenance. JSON duplicate keys rejected.
shared_schema.errors: CLI emits one JSON object with status error and exits 2 for validation, usage, decoding or file failures; success exits 0.

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated tickets with category, priority, accountable owner and original text
Deduplicated entries, unique-count themes, source ticket IDs, owner/priority provenance and exact prefix excerpts
Validated inferred interests, completed prerequisites, budget, exclusions and feedback provenance; preserved feedback counts support ranking

behavior.triage: Whole normalized phrase keyword count; lexical category tie-break; configurable fallback, owner and minimum priority; priority keywords can only escalate.
behavior.feedback: Case/punctuation/whitespace-normalized exact deduplication, preserving all ticket IDs and first 240 source characters. Themes count unique feedback, not duplicate tickets. Unmatched themes fall back to routed category.
behavior.adaptive: Select steps by experience OR preference/feedback tag overlap, recursively include prerequisites, omit completed steps; deterministic topological plan with reasons. Prerequisites may be included regardless of experience.
behavior.recommend: Filter availability, budget, explicit exclusions and uncompleted onboarding requirements. Planned steps never count as completed. Score = two per matching preference plus unique feedback count per matching theme; tie-break by price then ID; unmatched products provide budget-safe fallback.
behavior.tags: Theme names, preferences and product/step tags use exact case-sensitive shared vocabulary; only free-text keyword matching is normalized.
behavior.fixtures: All example customer text, product names, routing owners and onboarding instructions are explicitly synthetic.

verified: All four stages execute in order with validated handoffs
Cross-stage feedback provenance and recommendation scores
Prerequisite planning and completed-only recommendation gating
Configurable routing, priority and deterministic ties
Empty collections, invalid schemas, cycles and tampered stage output
CLI success, malformed JSON, invalid input, usage and missing-file errors
